## Skill families

| Concern | Skills |
| --- | --- |
| Setup | `cc-cli`, `cc-workspace` |
| Knowledge and design | `cc-knowledge`, `cc-system-design` |
| Outcome and plan | `cc-intent`, `cc-plan` |
| Execution | `cc-worktree`, `cc-dispatch`, `cc-stacked` |
| Requested review | `cc-review` |
| Delivery and closure | `cc-deliver`, `cc-complete` |
| Explicit direct work | `cc-direct` |

## Skills and native roles differ

A skill is a procedure read by an agent. A native role definition is a host-local configuration for a subagent. `agent setup` creates ignored role files for the supported hosts; it does not execute a skill or launch a worker.

Skills carry stage-specific details. Root instructions carry standing boundaries. Read only the procedures relevant to the task, then use host tools for actions already authorized by the person.
